fullContent:
Kukkutandatvak Bhasma – Benefits, Usage, Indications and Dosage 
 Reference: Ayurveda Saar Sangraha 
 Introduction 
 Kukkutandatvak Bhasma is prepared from the eggshell calcium [chicken eggshell]. According to Ayurveda it is a very potent source of calcium. It can also be called Kukkutanda Twak Bhasma, Eggshell calcium, Eggshell calx, eggshell Bhasma. It provides anti- inflammatory benefits. It is highly enriched with calcium, copper, zinc, magnesium. It gets easily absorbed because of being natural. It is used to treat diabetes, urinary disorders. It is a rejuvenator, aphrodisiac and also helps in forming RBCs. It also helps in pacifying Vata and Kapha. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Egg Shell 
 Indian sorrel (Oxalis corniculata) 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 The eggshells are cleaned and processed with Indian Sorrel’s juice to eradicate any contaminants and toxins. This purification helps in escalating its appropriateness for us to consume. These purified eggshells are then calcined to form the Bhasma. 
 Dosage 
 
 Adults – 125 mg to 500 mg 
 Children – 125 mg to 250 mg 
 It can be consumed twice every day. 
 
 Indications 
 
 Menstrual disorders 
 Helps in bone formation 
 Promotes sperm count 
 Aphrodisiac 
 Osteoporosis 
 Polyuria 
 Night fall 
 Promotes digestion 
 Rickets 
 Leucorrhea 
 Rheumatoid Arthritis 
 Osteomalacia 
 Osteoarthritis 
 
 Contraindications 
 There are no reported side effects of this formulation. 
 
 Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
